articles.summary: On track to achieve approximately $25 million in run-rate cost savings in FY26, with $50 million in incremental savings expected by 2030 H.B. Fuller Company (“H.B. Fuller” or “the Company”) (NYSE: FUL), the world’s largest pureplay adhesives company, today announced significant advancements on Project Quantum Leap, its multi-year supply chain transformation initiative designed to streamline operations, enhance manufacturing and distribution capabilities, and unlock shareholder value. Since outlining this program at its 2025 Investor Day, the Company has made meaningful progress on several major workstreams, with tangible benefits including: Optimizing its manufacturing network: By consolidating production into larger, more efficient facilities, H.B. Fuller has already reduced its global manufacturing footprint from 82 sites at the end of 2024 to 64 at the end of the third quarter of FY26. articles.title: H.B. Fuller Significantly Advances Project Quantum Leap with Announcement of Seven Site Closures
